label: blue_balloon
review: Agent visually inspected all 96 frame sheets and 285 crop thumbnails, then individual frames 7,10,17,67,83,86,89. Explicit blue-object labels only; manual individual boxes recover balloons omitted by group annotations. Agent then viewed all 23 rendered final crops on crops-000.jpg and approved their blue-balloon labels. Crops include partial, occluded, blurred, printed and pale blue balloons; no complete-scene annotation is claimed.
exclusion_policy: Every unselected queued crop and every unboxed object is excluded, NOT assigned background. Exclude all unverifiable-license frames, hot-air balloons, sculptures, purple/green balloons and ambiguous objects. These are public TRAIN photos, not competition footage or held-out qualification.
caveat: Manual boxes are approximate crop-classifier training boxes, not exhaustive scene labels or a detector evaluation set. Perceptual duplicate screening is heuristic. Multiple objects from one photo are not independent scenes.
